title: Ngāi Tahu takiwā mapped with GIS, 2010
altText: A 2010 contributor-created GIS map of the land recognised as Ngāi Tahu takiwā under the Ngāi Tahu Claims Settlement Act 1998. Not the Kā Huru Manu atlas; no assertion of legal boundary precision.
